faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about eligibility, study gaps, and embassy policies.
faq.q1: Can I apply if I have a significant study gap?
faq.a1: Yes! For Malaysia and several European nations, study gaps of up to 10+ years are accepted provided you can show authentic employment experience, freelancing portfolios, or professional activities during the gap period. UK and Canada also accept study gaps for Masters programs with valid job experience letters.
faq.q2: Is it possible to apply without IELTS?
faq.a2: Yes, many universities in Malaysia and the UK accept a Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate if your previous degree was taught in English. Additionally, Duolingo English Test (DET) or internal university exams are viable alternatives for many destinations.
faq.q3: What does "0 BDT File Opening Fee" really mean?
faq.a3: We do not collect any registration fee, profile evaluation charge, or upfront agency commission. You only pay standard third-party fees (such as embassy visa fees and university tuition deposits) directly to official bank accounts.
faq.q4: Can I bring my spouse with me?
faq.a4: Yes, Australia allows full unrestricted spouse work rights for postgraduate research and master's candidates. Canada allows spouse open work permits for select degree pathways, and Malaysia issues dependent passes for postgraduate students.
